about: The founder's 60 journeys (JOURNEY-SPECS.md, 2026-09-25, card t_18f80a89) mapped to the catalogue examples that show the moment each spec's success check describes. A journey with no honest example has examples [] and a section in catalogue/gaps/journeys.md. What happens outside the chat (a mail arriving, a phone notification, the live view, a calendar updating) is not a card; the note says so where the check depends on it. Checked by scripts/check-journeys.mjs.

journeys.title: Research and compare products
journeys.note: Three options with live prices and one pick; the marketplace and TV cards compare several retailers, and the partial one says which store didn't answer.

journeys.title: Buy an item end to end
journeys.note: The order receipt after the approval; the merchant's confirmation mail is outside the chat.

journeys.title: Build a cart for the user to finish
journeys.note: The cart with every item and a check-out link; nothing is ordered until the person finishes it.

journeys.title: Track orders and deliveries
journeys.note: Carrier status and ETA per order. No example lists two or more orders in one answer; that is the same rows shape with more rows.

journeys.title: Returns and return deadlines
journeys.note: The deadline per order, then the refund. The return submission itself is the approval card, and its confirmation is the merchant's mail.

journeys.title: Price-drop and restock watch
journeys.note: Setting the watch, and a price watch that fired (a hotel rate). The phone notification is outside the chat.

journeys.title: Negotiate a price / haggle
journeys.note: The offer message drafted for approval; it is sent only as approved.

journeys.title: Trip research and itinerary
journeys.note: A dated itinerary doc; flight and hotel prices come from the flights and hotels cards.

journeys.title: Find and compare flights
journeys.note: Direct options with fares, as of a time, one pick.

journeys.title: Book a flight
journeys.note: Booked after approval, with the approved total; the e-ticket mail is outside the chat.

journeys.title: Find and book a hotel
journeys.note: Options, one hotel, then the booking with ref, total and free-cancel date.

journeys.title: Trip logistics from booking emails
journeys.note: No example builds an itinerary from booking mails or adds the trip's events to the calendar. See catalogue/gaps/journeys.md.

journeys.title: Watch fares / hotel rates, rebook on drop
journeys.note: The watch fired: old and new rate, the saving, and the question to rebook.

journeys.title: Airport ride timed to the flight
journeys.note: The ride worked back from the flight. A delay that moves the ride is not drawn as its own card; the flight status card shows the delay.

journeys.title: Restaurant reservation
journeys.note: Options, then the booking with time, size and ref.

journeys.title: Doctor / dentist appointment
journeys.note: Slots after 17:00, the booking, and the call plan when the clinic doesn't book online.

journeys.title: Hair / beauty / wellness booking
journeys.note: Web booking of a slot, and a salon booked by phone with the agreed time.

journeys.title: Government / DMV appointment
journeys.note: Earliest slots with what to bring. The final confirmation page is in the live view, not a card.

journeys.title: Event tickets
journeys.note: Seats and fees adding to the total, then the tickets bought.

journeys.title: Reschedule or cancel a booking
journeys.note: Cancel with the fee and what can't be undone, then the venue's cancellation.

journeys.title: Inbox triage and daily brief
journeys.note: The threads that need the person, with deadlines.

journeys.title: Draft replies in my voice
journeys.note: The reply for approval, then the sent receipt.

journeys.title: Follow-up nudges (waiting-on)
journeys.note: Who hasn't replied, then the nudge for approval.

journeys.title: Clean up / unsubscribe
journeys.note: The plan for approval, then what was archived and unsubscribed.

journeys.title: Alert me when something important arrives
journeys.note: The watch set, and the alert when the mail arrived. The phone notification is outside the chat.

journeys.title: Extract leads / info into a sheet
journeys.note: The sheet of inquiries, one row each.

journeys.title: Week ahead / meeting prep brief
journeys.note: prod-agenda lists tomorrow's meetings and attendees but no prep note per meeting, which is what the check asks for. See catalogue/gaps/journeys.md.

journeys.title: Spot conflicts and double-bookings
journeys.note: The clashes with a fix each, then the approved move.

journeys.title: Find a time with others
journeys.note: Slots in both time zones, one pick, the invite drafted.

journeys.title: Add / move events
journeys.note: The move for approval, then the moved event and who got the update.

journeys.title: Protect focus time / buffers
journeys.note: Proposed focus blocks and buffers for next week.

journeys.title: Subscription audit
journeys.note: Each subscription with amount and next renewal date.

journeys.title: Cancel or downgrade a subscription
journeys.note: The cancel for approval, the cancellation, and the phone-only downgrade.

journeys.title: Lower a bill / dispute a charge
journeys.note: The dispute draft, and the call's agreed outcome.

journeys.title: Bill due-date tracking
journeys.note: Bills with due dates. Reminders before each due date use the home-reminder-recurring shape; the phone reminder is outside the chat.

journeys.title: Home upkeep and supply lists
journeys.note: Upkeep due, and the supplies running low.

journeys.title: Utility plan comparison
journeys.note: The current plan and alternatives with monthly and annual cost.

journeys.title: Deep research on a question
journeys.note: Three insurance plans compared with a pick, and a sourced brief.

journeys.title: Recurring digest on a topic
journeys.note: The digest as it arrives: 5 linked stories, every day at 07:00.

journeys.title: Watch listings (apartments, jobs, cars)
journeys.note: jobs-alert sets a listings watch and home-rent-listings shows a search, but no example shows the alert for a new listing, which is what the check asks for. See catalogue/gaps/journeys.md.

journeys.title: Answer from my documents
journeys.note: Clauses quoted from the person's own document, with the pages in Details.

journeys.title: Fill a web form
journeys.note: The filled form for approval, the step that needs the person, then the submitted values.

journeys.title: Paperwork deadlines from mail
journeys.note: Each deadline with its source mail and date.

journeys.title: Organize files
journeys.note: The moves for approval, then the folder with the 3 invoices.

journeys.title: Spending tracker from receipts
journeys.note: The month's spending sheet and totals by category. The sheet is built from accounts, not mail receipts; same shape.

journeys.title: Bank/card transaction monitoring
journeys.note: money-card-charges lists a week's charges, but no example sets a charge-over-threshold watch or shows its alert. See catalogue/gaps/journeys.md.

journeys.title: Tax prep document gathering
journeys.note: The checklist of tax documents, found or missing, with the source of each.

journeys.title: One-off and recurring reminders
journeys.note: One-off and recurring reminders set. The phone reminder is outside the chat.

journeys.title: Weekly review / planning
journeys.note: Last week's recap and the proposed blocks for next week.

journeys.title: Goals turned into plans
journeys.note: The plan with milestones and weekly check-ins.

journeys.title: Location-based reminders
journeys.note: The place reminder set. The phone reminder is outside the chat.

journeys.title: Email someone on my behalf
journeys.note: The sent receipt; couldn't-confirm when the send is unknown.

journeys.title: Text / WhatsApp / iMessage someone
journeys.note: The text for approval, delivered and read, and the honest WhatsApp can't.

journeys.title: Call a business for me
journeys.note: Who answered, what was agreed, and the transcript.

journeys.title: Invites and RSVPs
journeys.note: The invite, then who replied.

journeys.title: Find and compare local pros
journeys.note: Three local firms with rating and phone number, one pick.

journeys.title: Request quotes via web forms
journeys.note: Quotes requested and the replies as they arrive.

journeys.title: Check local stock
journeys.note: Stores near the person with the stock word and the time checked.

journeys.title: Meal plan + grocery list
journeys.note: The week's dinners with the grocery list; the basket is a separate yes.

journeys.title: Health questions and tracking
journeys.note: Sleep chart from the person's own device data.
